items.title: Spider beside a Camera
items.alt: One spider stands beside a small camera on a short tripod, one front leg touching the shutter and seven other legs distinct.
items.description: One spider stands beside a small camera on a short tripod, one front leg touching the shutter and seven other legs distinct. Useful for personal photo journal accents.

items.title: Spider Looking through a Telescope
items.alt: A spider leans toward a short telescope on a low stand, all eight legs visible around the stand.
items.description: A spider leans toward a short telescope on a low stand, all eight legs visible around the stand. Useful for night-sky storytelling.

items.title: Golden Spider Holding a Chess Knight
items.alt: Front-facing golden spider with eight legs holding a carved walnut chess knight, three rear legs fanned on each side.
items.description: A golden spider holds a walnut chess knight in a front-facing composition. Useful for personal game journals and storytelling activities.
